patch_description: Instead of relying on a fixed geometric pattern plus blind repulsion (which plateaus at 1.60), this approach treats the packing as a continuous optimization problem: the objective is the sum of the maximum feasible (water-filled) radii, which is always valid by construction. Starting from a staggered hex grid, it runs simulated annealing directly on circle centers — accepting moves with temperature-based probability, decaying temperature geometrically, with reheating when stuck. Because radii are recomputed as the maximal feasible assignment after each move, every candidate is valid, so the optimizer can climb straight toward the 2.635 target rather than only pushing circles apart. A fixed RNG seed keeps the constructor deterministic. Vectorized radius computation keeps the runtime modest.
